body.statement: Valiant's counting problem \(\mathrm{MONOTONE\ 2\mbox{-}SAT}\), which asks for the number of satisfying assignments of a conjunction of positive two-variable clauses, is \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete under polynomial-time oracle reductions.

source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 1. Problems 2--14 above are all \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the theorem and read together with the immediately preceding definition of problem 7.
